_readme: Hand-verified facts that override or extend the data files. Only add a value after checking it on an official source the same day. Every entry needs source URLs and a checked date. hours_spec feeds openingHoursSpecification in JSON-LD, so only add it when the hours come from the business itself (its site, its Facebook Page, or a listing the owner has claimed). Never add geo coordinates unless they come from an official record.

burns-florist._decision: Gap Build 01 (2026-11-11): ItemList side already Florist; a general florist rule in the place generator would also flip Burke's Florist and Cullman Florist (measured), which are outside the decided set, so the decided type is pinned per-entity. Basis: gap_build_2026-11-10/01-schema-type-audit-fix/audit_results.json.

hagar-guitars-llc._decision: Gap Build 01 (2026-11-11): a general guitar rule would also flip the separate hagar-guitars shops record (measured), outside the decided set, so the decided type is pinned per-entity. Basis: gap_build_2026-11-10/01-schema-type-audit-fix/audit_results.json.

quality-inn._decision: Gap Build 01 (2026-11-11): ItemList side already Hotel; the place generator's lodging rule emits LodgingBusiness for all 7 lodging records (measured), and only Quality Inn's type was decided, so the decided type is pinned per-entity. Basis: gap_build_2026-11-10/01-schema-type-audit-fix/audit_results.json.
